We trained our Muse foundational models, including Muse Wonder, at Prometheus, our gigawatt-scale supercluster in New Albany, Ohio.

Across a supercluster with hundreds of thousands of GPUs, even one underperforming host can slow an entire training run. We engineered Prometheus https://t.co/XXCih5wrfv

We’re working with partners to advance open standards, designs, and software for the next generation of AI factories.

Catch up in our OCP Global Summit recap:  https://t.co/XhfaXvmsLB

AI factories need to respond when the power grid needs relief.

At #OCPSummit26, NVIDIA’s Ian Buck explains how adjusting power use and shifting computing workloads can help, and why collaboration across the industry matters. https://t.co/2mbPq9cD2N
